verdict.rationale: Dedicated IP pools are listed on the pricing page and IP pool management is documented. A high-volume user also reports running dedicated IPs successfully, so the dedicated-IP part of the story holds. However, nothing in the pack documents warmup, either an automated ramp-up or a published warmup schedule, which is the story's distinguishing requirement. missing for 10: documented automated IP warmup or a published warmup schedule, guidance on when to move from shared pools to dedicated IPs, independent corroboration of the warmup process.
